# zh_runtime_allowlist.txt — Manual maintenance whitelist for MIXED_CN_EN rule.
#
# Format: one English token per line (case-insensitive). Each token is a
# Latin-script proper noun / abbreviation allowed to appear embedded in
# Chinese translated text without triggering the
# MIXED_CN_EN rule (plan v2 §2.3 row 2; rule predicates live in
# catch2-tests/test_zh_helpers.cc:rule_mixed_cn_en).
#
# This is the manual portion. The auto-generated enum English-name portion
# lives in zh_runtime_allowlist_enum.txt; at runtime the helpers' built-in
# whitelist (in test_zh_helpers.cc) collates a generous default set that
# covers resistance/stat tags, canonical god names, dungeon/branch names,
# and tech prefixes (Tele, Rage, Highlight, ...).
#
# Add new entries below when a false positive shows up in a Layer 1 run.
# Each row should be a single English run (no surrounding whitespace); any
# token ≥3 chars long that legitimately appears mid-Chinese translation
# ("你获得了 +1 Slay 增益") belongs here.

# Resistance / stat abbreviations (auto-builtin covers these but the file
# is kept for human-readable documentation).
